title: Tim Can Not See the Cat
lines: Tim can not see the cat.
"Is it in the tub?" said Mom.
Tim did not see it in the tub.
"Is it in the bin?" said Mom.
Tim can see a mop and a big bag.
Tim can tip the bag. A cat got up!
The cat sat on Tim. It can nap.

questions.listenFor: In the big bag. The story says it. If your child says the tub, read the line about the bag again together.

questions.ask: How did Tim find the cat?
questions.listenFor: He tipped the bag over and the cat got up. Listen for Tim doing the tipping - Mom gave ideas, but Tim did the looking.

questions.ask: Where else could Tim have looked for the cat?
questions.listenFor: Any spot. Mom named the tub and the bin; the bag is what worked. Ask what makes a good hiding spot.
